mapper.select: SELECT ss_claim.id AS id, ss_claim_stakeholder.id AS childId FROM ss_claim LEFT JOIN ss_claim_stakeholder ON ss_claim.id = ss_claim_stakeholder.related_id AND ss_claim_stakeholder.deleted=0 AND ss_claim_stakeholder.person_type=${personType} WHERE ss_claim.deleted=0 AND ss_claim.id IN ${idList}

SELECT Count(*) FROM ss_claim LEFT JOIN ss_claim_stakeholder ON ss_claim.id = ss_claim_stakeholder.related_id AND ss_claim_stakeholder.deleted=0 AND ss_claim_stakeholder.person_type=${personType} WHERE ss_claim.deleted=0 AND ss_claim.id IN ${idList}
